title: Jesus... Why Does Everyone In Class Understand Except Me?
topic: first in the family at college and lost in class

bible.text: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why does everyone in class understand except me?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I'm the first in my family to go to college. Everyone else had tuition and laptops. I just copy notes I don't understand.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You got here without any of that. That tells Me something about you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But I'm too scared to ask the professor. He'll think I don't belong there. 😔

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Asking isn't proof you don't belong. It's how anyone learns anything. Even the ones nodding are lost sometimes.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: And if I still fail? My whole family is counting on me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then we start again, together. You don't carry their hopes alone. Ask Me for help first. Then ask him.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Tomorrow, stay back after class and ask one question. Just one.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What's one question you've been too scared to ask? 🙏
